Overview

Armenia is a city in QU with a population of 300,000. A city in Colombia’s coffee triangle, known for its bamboo architecture and proximity to the Cocora Valley. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
